note: TC-233 NO-01..NO-04: a node_id ordinal is a JSON integer in 0..=9007199254740991 written canonically. Each ordinals entry is the raw JSON text of the ordinal member; the refusal is malformed_wire at the locus, with {i} the node's position. uniqueness_cases NO-05..NO-08 (FR-322-AC-272, FR-322-AC-273): each case adds sibling nodes, clones of the all-families fixture's derived Integer node, at the listed ordinals (placement "before" inserts them ahead of the original in graph order, "after" appends them). The original keeps ordinal 0. A refusal is invalid_semantic_graph at /semantic_graph/nodes/{i}/node_id of the sibling at index "at" among the added ones.
